authorized_scope: All remaining Library People & Relationships sources; production, no further general pilots.
authorization: User requested remaining People, batches, one Python worker, originals safe and every changed image checked.
source_review: Qualified visual review of each eligible source; same-concept peers support interpretation; never transfer masks automatically.
source_comparison: Different actual poses or subjects may share names. Single-style concepts remain in scope.
cleanup: Only reviewed strict-white core alpha becomes zero. Every RGB value and every other RGBA value stays exact.
output_review: Independent of source reviewer; every changed full image, every region and normal-size usefulness; identity/hash-bound record immediately after viewing.
acceptance: Only mechanically verified outputs with clear visual safety and clear worthwhile improvement. Otherwise retain original.
prior_work: Previously accepted safe deliverables remain valid under their recorded earlier policy; do not redo completed reviews without a specific reason.

storage.temporary_previews: bounded to active batches; remove after verified QA

reviewer_requirement: Qualified source and independent output reviewers; uncertain regions remain unchanged; no user approval required per batch.
